subject.title: fix stale app-state recovery for chat writes

question: After conflicts are resolved, must this state-recovery PR show a successful corrupted-store recovery on the exact rebased head, or is the historical success proof plus current-head failure-safety and race coverage sufficient?
rationale: Only a maintainer can accept the residual production risk where live provider access blocked successful validation of the redesigned exact head; automated review cannot substitute historical proof from the pre-redesign implementation.

options.title: Require exact-head success proof
options.body: Rebase the branch and require a redacted live run showing corrupted collection recovery, recovered-event persistence, and successful chat-write completion on that exact clean revision.

options.title: Accept combined evidence
options.body: Land after conflict resolution using the historical success run, current-head failure-safety output, regression suite, and race gates despite no successful exact-head recovery.

options.title: Pause for live access
options.body: Keep the PR open without further code churn until a suitable authenticated store can exercise the successful recovery path.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head success proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch and require a redacted live run showing corrupted collection recovery, recovered-event persistence, and successful chat-write completion on that exact clean revision.

likelyOwner.reason: They designed the final durability contract, performed the independent verification, and are best positioned to judge whether the remaining live-proof gap is acceptable.
